title: Top K Frequent Elements
description: Given an integer array `nums` and an integer `k`, return the `k` most frequent elements in descending order of frequency.

hints.content: Count element frequencies using a Hash Map.
Sort the distinct elements by frequency.
Alternatively, Bucket Sort achieves O(n) time by indexing frequency arrays.

solution.explanation:
Frequency map sorted descending by frequency, taking top k elements.
Time Complexity: O(n log n)
Space Complexity: O(n)
